Migrant worker presence reported to police in Meghalaya, checks in Andhra Pradesh

In Meghalaya, the Khasi Students' Union (KSU) has reported suspected undocumented migrant workers to the police. Meanwhile, in Andhra Pradesh's Rayalaseema region, migrant workers were reportedly absent as Booth Level Officers (BLOs) arrived for checks related to the Special Intensive Review (SIR). These events highlight concerns and administrative actions regarding migrant populations in different parts of India.
